scope: All regular readable UTF-8 files and recursively readable UTF-8 archive members, including Excel Office XML, document properties, and comments. Original data packages inspected without mutation. Unicode BOM U+FEFF is excluded from Arabic-script ranges.
limits: This checks script characters in readable UTF-8 text. Binary media and text encoded in other character sets do not receive a language certification. Historical checksum filenames and paths may retain FA suffixes as original provenance strings; they contain no Persian text.
